charge_port.notes: Porsche US/Canada: "CCS-equipped Taycan" needs the NACS DC adapter; CCS1 for North America. Native NACS starts with MY2027.

Canada: same programme; adapter free for MY2025 and MY2026, C$250 for MY2024 and older.
